description: This file contains a PHP class 'github' that provides a minimalistic implementation of GitHub API interactions, specifically tailored for TestLink integration. It includes methods for retrieving issues, comments, adding issues, and configuring cURL communication.

classes.name: github
classes.description: A PHP class providing a bare-bones interface to GitHub's REST API, supporting issue retrieval, comments, and issue creation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the github class with authentication details, repository info, and optional proxy configuration, then initializes cURL.

methods.name: initCurl
methods.description: Sets up the cURL resource with necessary options, including proxy support if configured.

methods.name: getIssueURL
methods.description: Retrieves the URL of a specific issue by its ID.

methods.name: getNotes
methods.description: Fetches comments associated with a specific GitHub issue.

methods.name: getIssue
methods.description: Fetches details of a specific issue by its ID.

methods.name: getIssues
methods.description: Retrieves a list of issues from the repository.

methods.name: addIssue
methods.description: Creates a new issue with a title and body.

methods.name: addNote
methods.description: Adds a comment to an existing issue.

methods.name: getIssueStatuses
methods.description: Returns the list of issue statuses supported ('open', 'closed').

methods.name: _get
methods.description: Helper method to perform GET requests to the API.

methods.name: _request_json
methods.description: Performs an HTTP request and decodes the JSON response.

methods.name: _request
methods.description: Performs an HTTP request with specified method, URL, and body, handling cURL options and errors.
